description: The Day Trader skill pack for Claude, B3 (Bovespa) edition: a fork of Jakeschincariol/day-trader-skill

plugins.name: day-trader-skill
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for day trading on B3: a chart scanner, a CVM news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager in lots of 100, an order ticket you type yourself (no automatic orders, enforced by an order guard hook), price alerts with live XP prices on request, an earnings analyst on CVM filings and an insider tracker.
